newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS raises net profit forecast at Nestle.
newsitem.headline: UBS raises net profit forecast at Nestle.

text.p: UBS Global Research raised its estimates for 1997-1999 net profit at Nestle SA after the food and beverage giant reported its 1996 results on Wednesday.
UBS analyst Alain-Sebastian Oberhuber said the higher forecasts were based on rising business volume in Europe, positive currency influences and a return to somewhat lower production costs.
